name: lean-paper-project-template
description: Repository-local build and validation commands for a Lean-linked paper.

scripts.build:pdf: mkdir -p tmp/tex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -output-directory=tmp/tex paper/main.tex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -output-directory=tmp/tex paper/main.tex && cp tmp/tex/main.pdf paper/main.pdf
scripts.check:paper: npm run build:pdf && npm run validate:links
